product_metadata.title: CLSYO Small Foot-Stool Ottoman, Under Desk Footrest Modern Home Living Room Bedroom Round Seat Stools, with 3 Gold Metal Legs 12 in (Green)
features: [Small Footstool]-The size of the modern foot stool is suitable for any small space. It is small in size and looks very light, but it is not easy to shake or break, and it is easy to store. It is suitable for sitting in a small space or resting your feet in the living room, so that your feet can get a comfortable position. Suitable for child seats or matching your recliner.

[Sturdy Quality]-The sturdy footrest includes 3 metal legs. There are non-slip pads under the feet to prevent scratches on the floor, and the velvet stool can withstand up to 220 pounds. Using high-quality materials, it can be used for many years.

[Easy Installation] - The screws and wrenches required for the installation of the small stool are all in the packaging bag, and the installation is convenient, and the installation can be completed in a few minutes. Size : Seat height 11.5” Seat diameter 12” Cushion thickness 1.69”. Note: In order to allow you to use the ottoman more safely, please do not stand on the stool! ! !

[Modern Design] -The low stool adopts a soft and lightweight design, and the velvet fabric feels super soft. Suitable for any family, living room, bedroom, children's playroom, study room, university dormitory, studio apartment, etc.

[Multifunctional Use] - The well-made velvet stool is easy to assemble, feels good, and the cushion is comfortable and soft. It not only provides a place to rest for the feet, but also can be used as an impromptu seat for guests, adult step stools, shoe stools at the door, and can sit on it short stool.
